verdict.rationale: x402 documents per-request HTTP 402 payment flows (quote price, sign payment, verify, settle) but nothing in the evidence describes a cart or order-draft object that an agent can create/update via a protocol call — the protocol is stateless pay-per-request, not cart/order management, and even the 'merchant checkout' integration mention (doc-13) only says agents can 'authorize payment sessions,' not manage draft orders. Missing for 10: any documented cart/order object, create/update API or protocol verbs, and evidence of persisted order state across calls.
